summary: Generated counts sum to 18 (3 per store); opened counts sum to 13 (2+3+1+2+3+2); recorded orders within seven days sum to 6 (1+2+0+1+1+1). Deterministic Node calculation: opened/generated = 13/18 = 0.7222222222222222 (72.22%); orders/generated = 6/18 = 0.3333333333333333 (33.33%); orders/opened = 6/13 = 0.46153846153846156 (46.15%). extraction_method: manual CSV inspection and Node.js deterministic arithmetic; command: node -e "const generated=[3,3,3,3,3,3].reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); const opened=[2,3,1,2,3,2].reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); const orders=[1,2,0,1,1,1].reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); console.log(JSON.stringify({generated,opened,opened_rate:opened/generated,orders,orders_per_alert:orders/generated,order_records_per_opened_alert:orders/opened}))"; raw output: {"generated":18,"opened":13,"opened_rate":0.7222222222222222,"orders":6,"orders_per_alert":0.3333333333333333,"order_records_per_opened_alert":0.46153846153846156}
limitations: Synthetic records, alert-record denominators only, not unique stores/SKUs or eligible population. Opens/orders are not evidence of alert-caused orders or prevented stockouts; no stockout measure or comparator.
